facts.text: Under Fredonia in 4, the university covers tuition and fees for extra courses if a student's graduation is delayed due to unavailable classes.

sources.title: Fredonia in Four | Fredonia.edu
sources.quote: Furthermore, if a student's graduation is delayed due to our inability to provide the appropriate courses, the university will pay the necessary Fredonia tuition and course-related fees required to complete the degree.
